feature_name: Preferred zone selection for cloned instances
summary: Cloud SQL lets you specify preferred zones when cloning zonal or regional instances to improve future zone reassignment behavior and reduce downtime.
extended_definition: Cloud SQL lets you specify preferred zones when cloning zonal or regional instances to improve future zone reassignment behavior and reduce downtime.
